analysis.summary: Management reported a standalone revenue from operations of 1,173.25 Lakhs and consolidated revenues of 11,642.04 Lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The company's standalone net profit increased to 3,753.55 Lakhs, while consolidated net profit stood at 6,853.79 Lakhs. Management highlighted strong global offshore activity, fleet optimization of the Prabha DP2 accommodation barge through subsidiary operations, and ongoing international expansion including the incorporation of Beluga International (IFSC) Private Limited in GIFT City. No dividend was recommended for the financial year due to planned capital expenditures. Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited submitted its Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting financial results, operational updates, and various corporate actions.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) is high due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.

demand_outlook.claim: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favorable, supported by sustained offshore investment, increasing demand for specialized marine assets, and limited fleet additions.
demand_outlook.quote: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favourable, supported by sustained offshore investment, increasing demand for specialised marine assets and limited fleet additions.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to become the world's largest source of oil demand growth this decade.
demand_outlook.quote: As energy transitions gather pace and China’s economy shifts gear towards a less energy-intensive phase, India will assume the position as the world’s largest source of oil demand growth this decade.

demand_outlook.claim: The market is expected to remain buoyant due to ONGC proposing high-value tenders in brown and green fields.
demand_outlook.quote: The market is expected to remain buoyant in the coming years as ONGC proposes to come out with many high value tenders in brown & green fields.

demand_outlook.claim: Platform Supply Vessels are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: PSV are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.
capex_expansion.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.

capex_expansion.claim: Strategic expansion in vessel acquisition will be financed through a combination of debt and equity.
capex_expansion.quote: This strategic expansion will be financed through a combination of debt and equity, aligning with the company’s growth ambitions and current market dynamics.

capex_expansion.claim: Beluga International DMCC incorporated a Dubai subsidiary for ship chartering, including renting and leasing water-transport boats, barges, and tugs.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is incorporated for the purpose of carrying out the activities relating to ship charter including renting and leasing of water-transport boats, Barges & Tugs and for passenger transport or cargo, whether owned by the company or being re-chartered.

orders_capacity.claim: Prabha is a Dynamically Positioned Vessel (DP2) accommodation Work Barge with a capacity of 275 People, Deck Space of 1200 sq. meter and 330-ton crane.
orders_capacity.quote: Prabha is a Dynamically Positioned Vessel (DP2) accommodation Work Barge with a capacity of 275 People, Deck Space of 1200 sq. meter and 330-ton crane and the same is owned by Beluga International DMCC, UAE which is 100% subsidiary of DOEIL.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued 8,42,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each to eligible qualified institutional buyers through a qualified institutions placement.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has issued 8,42,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each to eligible qualified institutional buyers through a qualified institutions placement under Chapter VI of the SEBI ICDR Regulations.

capital_allocation.claim: The company sub-divided one equity share having a face value of Rs. 10 into 10 equity shares having a nominal face value of Rs. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has sub-divided 1(One) Equity Share having nominal/face value of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten Only) into 10 (Ten) Equity Shares having nominal/face value of Rs. 1/- (Rupees One Only) each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry, and fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand and affect profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in Oil Prices: Offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry. Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global economic slowdowns can lead to reduced investment in offshore projects and lower utilization rates for offshore vessels.
risks_headwinds.quote: Economic Downturns: Global economic slowdowns can lead to reduced investment in offshore projects, leading to lower utilization rates for offshore vessels.

risks_headwinds.claim: Collisions, groundings, or accidents in offshore operations can result in significant financial losses and environmental damage.
risks_headwinds.quote: Accidents and Collisions: Offshore operations are complex and hazardous. Collisions, groundings, or accidents can result in significant financial losses and environmental damage.

risks_headwinds.claim: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks to crew members.
risks_headwinds.quote: Weather and Sea Conditions: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks to crew members.

management_commitments.claim: Approval of members is sought for related party transactions during the conclusion of the 47th Annual General Meeting till the conclusion of the 48th Annual General Meeting to be held in the financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Approval of the Members is being sought for transactions during the conclusion of 47th Annual General Meeting of the Company till the conclusion of 48th Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held in the financial year 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company's board sought approval for related party transactions spanning three financial years from FY 2024-25 to FY 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: Approval of the Board is being sought for transactions during the Three (3) Financial years (i.e. from 2024-25 till Financial Year 2026-27)
